142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
147	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).

149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
151	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.
154	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on
157	  `gravity-ui.com/icons` or ask the user — do not invent one. Then pass it as an
158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
159	  `references/icons.md`.

161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
163	  a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, controls on a brand background) live in
164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.

166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

179	  read in Step 1, it does not exist — do not write `variant=`, `color=`,
180	  `name=` (on `Icon`), or a `header-3` variant. Use the documented prop or
181	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
182	- **Do not use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias as a fallback.** It
183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.

187	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

196

198	
199	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:

204	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
213	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

## Theming

### Styles + fonts are required; order matters

❌ **Incorrect** — missing imports, or theme before base:

```tsx
import './theme.css';                                  // before styles.css → gets overwritten
import {ThemeProvider} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
// no styles.css, no fonts.css → components render unstyled
```

✓ **Correct**:

```tsx
import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css';           // fonts first
import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css';          // then base
import './theme.css';                                  // custom ALWAYS after styles.css
import {ThemeProvider} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
```

**Why:** without `styles.css` + `fonts.css` imported once at the entry point,
every component renders unstyled. A custom theme file imported *before*
`styles.css` is overwritten by it in the cascade — custom always comes after.

### `theme` takes five values — no `"default"` or `"auto"`

❌ `<ThemeProvider theme="default">`
❌ `<ThemeProvider theme="auto">`
✓ `<ThemeProvider theme="light">` / `"dark"` / `"light-hc"` / `"dark-hc"`
✓ `<ThemeProvider theme="system">` (resolves to light/dark from OS preference)

### Branding means a full token set, on both themes — never 2–4 tokens

❌ **Incorrect** — partial override:

```css
.g-root { --g-color-base-brand: #007AFF; }
```

✓ **Correct** — override the full brand group, per theme:

```css
.g-root_theme_light {
  --g-color-base-brand: #007AFF;
  --g-color-base-brand-hover: #0066D6;
  --g-color-base-selection: rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.05);
  --g-color-base-selection-hover: rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.1);
  --g-color-line-brand: #007AFF;
  --g-color-text-brand: #007AFF;
  --g-color-text-brand-contrast: #FFFFFF;   /* required: text on brand bg */
  --g-color-text-link: #007AFF;
  --g-color-text-link-hover: #0066D6;
}
.g-root_theme_dark {
  /* different values — dark usually needs a brighter brand */
  --g-color-base-brand: #2E8BFF;
  /* … same set, dark-tuned … */
}
```

**Why:** the semantic layer has many tokens pointing at "brand" — selection,
focus, links, the contrast text on a brand background. Override only
`--g-color-base-brand` and you get a UI where the button is branded but
selection, links and focus rings are still the default accent. Provide the full
set, and provide it for *each* theme you support (dark themes usually need a
brighter brand than light). Forgetting `--g-color-text-brand-contrast` makes
text on a brand button unreadable.

Better than hand-writing: generate the full set with the
[Themer](https://gravity-ui.com/themer) web tool or
[`@gravity-ui/uikit-themer`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/uikit-themer) — both
recalculate the dependent palette from a single base color.

### A section `ThemeProvider` with no provider above it themes the whole page

❌ **Incorrect** — a dark widget mounted where no `ThemeProvider` (or v8
`Provider`) wraps it: an embedded widget, a micro-frontend, a separate React
root:

```tsx
<ThemeProvider theme="dark">   {/* no provider above → writes to document.body */}
  <Toolbar />
</ThemeProvider>
```

✓ **Correct**:

```tsx
<ThemeProvider scoped theme="dark">
  <Toolbar />
</ThemeProvider>
```

**Why:** only the outermost `ThemeProvider` writes the theme class to
`document.body` — globally, last-wins. One nested inside another
`ThemeProvider` (or a v8 `Provider`) is always scoped, with or without the prop,
so a dark section inside the app needs no `scoped`. With no provider above,
`scoped` renders a dedicated `<div class="g-root g-root_theme_dark">` around the
children *and* updates the theme React context (so `useTheme` inside the
section sees the section's theme). For a CSS-only region without context, apply
the class manually: `<div className={getRootClassName({theme: 'dark'})}>`.

### Controls on a brand/colored background: fixed contrast, both themes

❌ **Incorrect** — default button on a brand-colored hero:

```tsx
<section style={{background: 'var(--g-color-base-brand)'}}>
  <Button>Sign up</Button>   {/* default view follows theme → low contrast on bright bg */}
</section>
```

✓ **Correct** — use a `*-contrast` view, which is built for a contrast
background, or scope a CSS override fixing contrast for both themes:

```tsx
<section style={{background: 'var(--g-color-base-brand)'}}>
  <Button view="normal-contrast">Sign up</Button>   {/* also outlined-contrast, flat-contrast */}
</section>

Виджет `ChartWidget` готов. Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) и `vite build` проходят. В браузере я его не запускал: по правилам скилла dev-сервер без запроса не поднимаю.

## Что получилось

- **Единый API.** Виджет принимает `sales` (обычный линейный график), `monitoring` (плотный временной ряд) и `mode` / `defaultMode` / `onModeChange`. Режим можно задавать снаружи или оставить виджету. Переключатель — `SegmentedRadioGroup` из uikit.
- **Движки.**
  - Режим `sales` рисует `@gravity-ui/charts`.
  - Режим `monitoring` рисует `@gravity-ui/yagr`.
  - Оба подключены через `@gravity-ui/chartkit`. Это пакет для нескольких движков за одним `<ChartKit type=… />`.
- **Ленивая загрузка.** Плагины подключаются через динамический `import()` в `engines.ts`. В сборке `GravityChartsWidget` (568 kB) и `YagrWidget` (243 kB) вышли отдельными чанками. Входной чанк на них статически не ссылается.
- **Состояния.** Пока движок грузится, показывается `Loader`. Если чанк не загрузился, виджет показывает `Alert` с кнопкой «Retry», а повторная попытка возможна. Пустые данные показываются текстом через `renderError`.
- **Демо.** В `src/App.tsx` виджет показан с 30 днями продаж и 3×2000 точек мониторинга. В мониторинге есть разрыв в данных.

Код лежит в `src/widgets/ChartWidget/` (`ChartWidget.tsx`, `engines.ts`, `useEngine.ts`, `adapters.ts`, `types.ts`), демо-данные — в `src/data.ts`.

## Версии

В проекте закреплён uikit 7.43.0. Последние версии chartkit 9 и charts 2 требуют uikit ^8, поэтому я поставил совместимые с uikit 7: `chartkit@^8.12.0`, `charts@^1.73.0`, `yagr@^5.3.1`. Если позже перейдёте на uikit 8, версии стоит поднять.

## Что проверить вручную

`tsc` не проверяет вёрстку и контраст. Стоит посмотреть:
- светлую и тёмную темы (yagr берёт тему из `ThemeProvider`);
- узкий экран (~375px) и широкий (~1400px) на горизонтальный overflow;
- переключение режимов туда-обратно и состояние ошибки загрузки.

`npm install` сообщил о 5 уязвимостях в зависимостях. Я их не трогал.
